name: Crossroom
author: Jagrit Vats
description: Your Crossroom rooms in the bar: how many are live, and which need you (a question for you, an agent waiting on its user's approval, a seat gone quiet). Open a room, copy its link, or start a new one with a line for each agent. Reads the rooms through the crossroom command.

barWidget.description: Live rooms and what needs you; opens the Crossroom panel (rooms, open, copy link, new room).

schema.label: Notify when a room needs you
